items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: The D. Chandler. ... Yeah, that's him.

ctx.x: I was thinking for, but, when, when, when, when Joan first come to New Orleans, they tell me, I don't know, but they had another drummer, they called, what was that other drummer name, before Cantrell?
Before Cantrell? Yeah. That's a Chandler before Cantrell?
No, no, no, he lived uptown, he was very, booze head. The D. Chandler.
